## Triage: first touch → `domain:skills` · p2 · 2026-11-15T15:19Z

⛔ Not a claim. Requested by eval#1 (mailbox comment 6896730284).

20 of the 121 failed in-chat writes trace to how the AI built the app, which the authoring skills steer:

- a line-item add path that leaves the amount at 0, because the persona cannot set or compute it;
- a persona create policy that needs a value the user never says.

The maintainer pointed here (「聊天里改数据 出问题的关键还是我们的skills需要优化吧？」). The guidance reaches every model that builds, the hosted one included. That is the product write experience, so **p2**. The work is in `skills/**` (published), owned by skills#2.

Attribution note 2026-11-16T06:01Z for point 2: the cross matrix #34320 shows the task-create 403 follows the **ask** model, not the build (haiku and sonnet asks fail on an opus build too; opus asks pass on a haiku build), so "haiku builds only, none from opus" in the body is wrong. The rule asked here is unchanged and is now the main lever: default the persona-tied field (or describe it so an agent sets it), because the weaker ask models do not infer it from a bare 403.
